reviews.comment: I would do everything in my power to not take this class with Campbell. She is nice but very strict. This was my first B in college and I really did try in her class. Quizzes are every week and only 3-4 questions each. Very concept heavy - you will not get away with memorizing. There is extra credit though, which was nice.

She's okay. I will say, for an 8am, it is slightly irritating having her as a professor because she is not very easy-going at all. She is way too literal when it comes to absences or being late, mistakenly counting students absent who are present all the time, some slight disorganization, strict on no phones, etc.. I get it, but it's 8am.

Dr. Campbell is a nice person, but not the best teacher. Her class wasn't hard if you did what was required of you. She teaches directly from slides that she creates and makes all her own test questions. If you read through the slides and go to the review lecture you'll do fine on the tests. Also don't miss in-class activities!

Mess of a class it was all over the place and the grading criteria was actually absurd. There was patterns of people getting answers wrong when they give the word for word correct response. Near to impossible to get a 100 on any assignments.

Very nice lady! But she grades pretty hard, its not terrible but youll probably never get 100 on anything written. Quizzes in class so dont skip. It was all concept based too so that was kinda hard and the exams asked very specific questions. There is a chance for extra credit though

A mess from the syllabus quiz to the last test it was all over the place. A dysfunctional online class that is unclear on many assignments and their criteria. I would wait until another professor to take this class.
She was nice but I felt the lectures were confusing and the assignments were confusing at first as well. The group projects and tests are the majority of the grade. Accessible outside of class.

Dr. Campbell is a good prof! While I didn't love the clutter and disorganization (broken links, messy slides) or the group work (discussion/projects), I learned a lot. Dr. Campbell's lectures are straightforward, and she's very helpful. Lots of grades (including participation/pop quizzes) and LOTS of extra credit opportunities! Overall an easy A!!

Professor Campbell cares about her students tremendously. Her instructions for papers and in class assignments are very clear and she is always willing to answer any and all questions that you have. I would definitely recommend taking her class because it is very interesting and offered unique perspectives.
Dr. Campbell is a great professor who knows a great amount about the topics in this class. She is always open for discussion and really get's you thinking.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell maintained a classroom environment that was engaged. I understood the criteria for assignments clearly. Dr. Campbell's utilized interesting lectures and allowing us to break out with groups to discuss a topic. Dr. Campbell was always very helpful and kind through out the semester. She wanted me to be successful in her class.

I highly recommend taking Professor Campbell for comm 480! She fostered a very warm environment for learning and was really kind. She cares about how you are doing and gives great feedback on papers. Lectures were very interesting and engaging as there were in-class activities every class. I learned a lot from this class and gained valuable skills

Professor Campbell is very caring and fosters a warm and welcoming learning environment. She cares about how you are doing in the class and is very kind. Class lectures are informative, interesting, and engaging as there are in-class activities almost every class. Highly recommend taking comm 480 with her! I learned a lot and gained valuable skills

Professor Campbell was a very easy going professor, I enjoyed her class and took lots away from it. Highly recommend her for Comm 480, you won't be dissapointed (even though it says Comm330, I took her comm480 class and couldn't find an option for it on ratemyprof
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took COMM 480 with Professor Campbell and she was a great instructor. She is an expert at the topic she teaches on, having researched it for many years. She cares about her students and works really hard to make sure the understand the material and have a good time doing it.

Honestly, I think I am still irritated by a grade she gave me. We had an extra credit assignment where we needed to submit our idea for approval first. I submit mine and she approves then proceeds to give me a 40 because the idea wasn't what she said was allowed so I'm just like why did you approve my idea at all? In this Ted Talk I will....

I have had professor Campbell twice now and I have disliked her in both classes. She does not provide helpful advice and has been rude to me on many occasions. Her legitimate advice to me one time was "just don't try so hard" after critiquing my "well-rehearsed" speech. Honestly hope I never have to take a class from her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Campbell online this semester, & I thoroughly enjoyed her class. There are a ton of extra credit opportunities & breakout room discussions (which sometimes are followed by pop quizzes). Even though her class is pretty tough, it's not impossible to get an A! Use the exam reviews, & always take advantage of the EC opportunities she gives!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took Professor Campbell online this semester, and it has been so nice to have a great online class for once. She knows the information well, will try to help you succeed in the class, and is available for discussion outside of class. She has made this class interesting and I have learned a lot without feeling overwhelmed!

This class was pretty hard. The reason being was because the quizzes and exams are pretty tricky. Multiple choice for the most part but some of the choices will relate to the theory yet it'll be wrong. Made a 45 on the second exam that I thought I did great on. She does curve every now and again though. Not a bad professor. Just very precise.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Surprised to see a lot of negative reviews. Dr. Campbell was super sweet, albeit a little kooky. Lectures were clear and powerpoints were helpful. Not really a fan of how much group work there is, but most of the assignments are fairly easy. Tests are manageable if you pay attention during lectures.

One of the toughest professor's I have had in college thus far. Her powerpoints are not posted till after class, a week later, she changed the syllabus half way through the semester adding in pop quizzes no one knew about, her instructions are NEVER clear, and her tests are hard and nothing like the study guides. I could go on and one. DO NOT TAKE!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: 100% the worst professor I've had. Her class put me in a bad mood. Unclear expectations and unorganized power points. Takes her months to grade. Guidelines for assignments are almost never posted or are very unclear, and when you ask her a question about them, she responds rudely, even though she didn't even post the right info. DO NOT TAKE HER!!

Good prof, grades fairly easy! Class consisted of 3 tests (no final) and a 2 part group project. I would definitely recommend Prof Campbell. This class isn't difficult to get an A if you go to class and study!

Very unclear expectations and unorganized power points. She is one of those professors that doesn't upload your grades to ecampus, you have to go into her office hours and ask her what your grade for every assignment is. She never meets her grading deadlines for tests either. Take a different prof for this class if you can!

I really like Dr. Campbell. This class was interesting as well as fun. The tests were pretty fair. She offers extra credit opportunities to go on your final grade. I would sometimes get distracted though because her voice sounds EXACTLY like ellen degeneres. I would def take another class with her.
